intentions: Define and manage expense categories with unique names, descriptions, optional monthly budgets, and icons
Store and retrieve expenses with detailed metadata including amount in cents, date, category, payment method, and recurrence status
Enforce unique monthly budget constraints per category using SQLite table-level uniqueness
Implement repository patterns for SQLite-based data access with CRUD and filtering capabilities
Provide business logic services for expense operations including filtering, aggregation, budget checking, and reporting
Support filtering and querying expenses by date range, category, payment method, and recurrence
Enable monthly and yearly financial reports with budget status indicators
Allow CSV export of filtered expense data
Detect recurring expenses with consistent amount and category patterns
Build a CLI interface using Click with nested commands for managing categories, budgets, and expenses
Ensure all monetary values are stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point errors
Use auto-incremented primary keys with optional ID fields in domain models
Implement custom exception classes for domain-specific errors (CategoryNotFound, ExpenseNotFound, BudgetExceeded)
Enable foreign key constraints in SQLite to maintain referential integrity between models
Support optional parameters in commands and queries with default behavior for missing filters
